series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits mixed trend direction and moderate seasonality with high noise levels. Concept drift is detected, and model rankings are unstable. A weighted combination with dynamic error adaptation is recommended to account for shifting model performance and high noise.

reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.8: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → ADE methods adapt to shifting model performance via error-weighted averaging, crucial for concept drift scenarios (Gaillard & Goude 2015)
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.recommended_knobs.top_k=4 AND shrinkage=0.35 → Regularized inverse-RMSE weights balance model performance differences while avoiding overfitting with few validation windows (Hansen et al. 2011)
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → Per-horizon selection exploits differentiated model accuracy across forecast horizons (Timmermann 2006)
reasoning.trimmed_mean_r0.10: series_profile.model_landscape.rankings_stable=false → Trimmed mean mitigates instability from outlier models in unstable ranking environments (Genre et al. 2013)

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.combination_recommendation.avoid=ridge_stacking AND model_landscape.concept_drift=true → Ridge stacking overfits with few windows and fails to adapt to concept drift
